title: [Chassis][voq] brcm_sai_clear_buffer_pool_stats errors seen intermittently
author: arlakshm
body:

#### Description

<!--
     Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. When run the `test_qos_sai.py` on the voq chassis. This error `SAI_API_BUFFER:brcm_sai_clear_buffer_pool_stats:2874 Unsupported buffer pool type 2` is seen intermittently in the syslog causing loganalyzer to mark the test as error. 
```

'match_files': {'/tmp/syslog.str3-sonic-lc3-1.2024-11-15-03:00:23': {'expected_match': 0,
                                                                     'match': 1}},
 'match_messages': {'/tmp/syslog.str3-sonic-lc3-1.2024-11-15-03:00:23': ['2024 '
                                                                        'Nov '
                                                                        '15 '
                                                                        '02:57:13.662182 '
                                                                        'str3-sonic-lc3-1 '
                                                                        'ERR '
                                                                        'syncd0#syncd: '
                                                                        '[06:00.0] '
                                                                        'SAI_API_BUFFER:brcm_sai_clear_buffer_pool_stats:2874 '
                                                                        'Unsupported '
                                                                        'buffer '
                                                                        'pool '
                                                                        'type '
                                                                        '2\n']},

```
#### Describe the results you received:
Unexpected error logs in syslog

#### Describe the results you expected:
These errors logs should not be seen in syslog

#### Output of `show version`:
202405
